root.name: チャーター・コミュニケーションズ

relations.text: Spectrum Mobileはベライゾンの携帯電話網を利用して全国をカバーしている
relations.text_en: Spectrum Mobile uses the Verizon cellular network for nationwide coverage

source.label: Charter 10-K(2025年12月31日)
source.quote: We leverage the Verizon cellular network to provide nationwide coverage including unlimited calls, text and data using Verizon’s fourth generation and fifth generation (“5G”) service including their latest 5G technology.

relations.text: 動画サービスで、主にベライゾンと競合している
relations.text_en: Charter's video service competes primarily with Verizon

source.label: Charter 10-K(2025年12月31日)
source.quote: Our residential video service also faces competition from large telecommunications companies, primarily Verizon, which offer wireline video services in significant portions of our operating areas.

relations.text: 2025年7月、Spectrum Business向けモバイルの提供にT-Mobileの網を使う複数年契約を結んだ
relations.text_en: In July 2025 Charter signed a multi-year agreement to use T-Mobile's network for Spectrum Business mobile

source.label: Charter 10-K(2025年12月31日)
source.quote: In addition, in July 2025, we entered into a multi-year agreement with T-Mobile US, Inc. (“T-Mobile”) to use their network to deliver mobile services to Spectrum Business customers which is set to launch in 2026.

companies.name: ロサンゼルス・レイカーズ

relations.text: レイカーズの地元放送試合すべての配信権を2032年まで持つ
relations.text_en: Charter holds rights to distribute all locally available Lakers games through 2032

source.label: Charter 10-K(2025年12月31日)
source.quote: We have an agreement with the Los Angeles Lakers for rights to distribute all locally available Los Angeles Lakers’ games through 2032.

relations.text: 取り扱い端末にアップルの5G機種が含まれる
relations.text_en: Charter's device lineup includes 5G models from Apple

source.label: Charter 10-K(2025年12月31日)
source.quote: Our device portfolio includes 5G models from Apple, Google and Samsung

relations.text: 2025年に、Spectrum Newsをコムキャストの映像契約者へ広げる契約を結んだ
relations.text_en: In 2025 Charter agreed with Comcast to expand distribution of Spectrum News to Comcast video customers

source.label: Charter 10-K(2025年12月31日)
source.quote: In 2025, we entered into an agreement with Comcast to expand distribution of Spectrum News to their video customers in California, Connecticut, northern New Jersey, Orlando and Tampa.

companies.name: AT&T(エーティーアンドティー)

relations.text: 光ファイバー(FTTH)の主な競合である
relations.text_en: AT&T is one of Charter's primary FTTH competitors

source.label: Charter 10-K(2025年12月31日)
source.quote: AT&T Inc. ("AT&T") and Verizon are our primary FTTH competitors.

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
